HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_HARVESTFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: Celebrate your Villagers' hard work with a **Harvest Festival**!
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_HARVESTFESTIVAL_TEXT_2: During this customisable event, you raise your **score** by **providing** new **temporary Festive Needs** to your **Villagers**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_HARVESTFESTIVAL_TEXT_3: The **higher** your **score** is, the **better** the **rewards** you unlock.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: To start your first Harvest Festival, you need to:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_2: Unlock the **Tavern**, **Tavern Kitchen**, and **Festival Grounds** in the Progression Screen (**Ctrl+P by default**).
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_3: Build a **Tavern Kitchen** in your **Tavern**, so **Cooks** can prepare **Festive Meals**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_4: Add a **Festival Grounds** to your **Tavern** to start working on your **Harvest Festival**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_5: Open the **Harvest Festival Setup Window** to place **Festive Meal Tables** and **Entertainment Sites**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTFESTIVAL_TEXT_6: Select **Festive Meals** and **Entertainers** in the **Harvest Festival Setup Window**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: For a **successful Harvest Festival**, you must prepare **three** key **elements**: **Festive Meals**, **Festive Entertainers**, and **Festive Drinks**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_3: **Accessibility**: Ensure Festive Meal Tables are easily accessible to both Cooks and Villagers.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_4: **Production**: Assign enough Cooks to your Tavern Kitchen.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_5: **Resources**: Stock enough ingredients to prepare meals for everyone.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_7: **Accessibility**: Place Entertainment Sites where Villagers can easily reach them.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_8: **Space**: Leave enough spectator space in front of each Entertainment Site.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_9: **Funds**: Ensure you have enough Coins to hire your chosen Entertainers.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_PREPARINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_11: **Accessibility**: Ensure Festive Drink Tables are easily accessible to Taverners and Villagers.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_1: **Villagers**, **Monastics**, and **Combatants** will attend the Harvest Festival if their **housing** is located within the **Festival Attractiveness** area.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_2: You can increase **Festival Attractiveness** in several ways:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_3: **Place Festival Parts**: Add Harvest Festival Parts like Festive Meal Tables and Festival Decorations.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_4: **Group Parts**: Place multiple Festival Parts close together to multiply your Attractiveness area.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_5: **Offer Variety**: Select different Festive Meals, Festive Drinks, and Festive Entertainers for an additional multiplier.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ATTRACTINGVILLAGERS_TEXT_6: **Expand** your **Attractiveness** coverage area to **reach** more **homes**. **More attendees** mean a **higher** final **score**!
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_1: Villagers attending a Harvest Festival acquire **Festive Needs**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_2: **Festive Meals**: The Villager must consume a Festive Meal at a Meal Table.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_3: **Festive Drinks**: The Villager must consume a Festive Drink at a Drink Table.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_4: **Festive Entertainers**: The Villager must visit an Entertainment Site.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_6: **Temporary Replacement**: While the event is active, Villagers' Essential Needs and Additional Needs are temporarily paused.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_7: **Score Generation**: Fulfilling a Villager's Festive Needs increases the event's score.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_8: **No Shortage**: Unfulfilled Festive Needs carry no penalties.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALNEEDS_TEXT_9: **Villagers** will begin **fulfilling** these **Festive Needs** as soon as the **Harvest Festival starts**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_CELEBRATINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: Once you begin **preparing** for a **Harvest Festival**, your **Villagers** will spend a **few days** getting **ready**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_CELEBRATINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_7: From this point until the **Harvest Festival** ends:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_CELEBRATINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_8: **Festival Needs are Fulfilled**: Villagers visit the Festival Grounds after work to satisfy their Festive Needs.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_CELEBRATINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_9: **Points are Earned**: You earn a point for each Festive Need fulfilled by Villagers and Festival Guests.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_CELEBRATINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_10: When the **Harvest Festival ends**, you will **earn rewards** based on your **total score**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALREWARD_TEXT_1: **Complete Harvest Festivals** to earn **rewards** based on your **final Tier**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALREWARD_TEXT_2: **One-time Unlockables**: New Festival Parts, Entertainers, Festival Recipes, etc.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALREWARD_TEXT_3: **Recurring Rewards**: Villager Happiness Bonus, Immigrating Serfs, Trade Price Bonus, etc.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALREWARD_TEXT_4: **Higher Tiers** yield **better rewards**, **many** of which **provide** the **boost** needed to **reach higher scores** in later events.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FESTIVALREWARD_TEXT_5: Open the **Harvest Festival Preparation Book** from the **Festival Grounds** building window to **review** all available **rewards**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ESTATEINVITATION_TEXT_1: You can **invite** dignitaries of the three **Estates of the Realm** to attend your **Harvest Festival**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ESTATEINVITATION_TEXT_2: To invite dignitaries, you need to:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ESTATEINVITATION_TEXT_3: **Fulfil requirements**: Select their specific options during your Harvest Festival Setup.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ESTATEINVITATION_TEXT_4: **Send Estate Invitations**: Spend Estate Invitations earned from Harvest Festivals. You can invite several dignitaries at once.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_ESTATEINVITATION_TEXT_9: **Reward** you if you achieve a high enough score.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_1: Unlocking **Animal Farming** in the **Progression Screen** (Ctrl+P by default) gives you access to the **Common Croft**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_2: Before starting, ensure you have a steady supply of **Fodder resources**, such as **Cabbages**, **Turnips**, **Wheat**, or **Hazelnuts**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_3: Building a **Common Croft** requires **two essential parts**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_6: To get a Croft up and running:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_7: **Build**: Place at least one Animal Pen and one Fodder Depot.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_8: **Supply**: Assign a Fodder resource to the Fodder Depot.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_9: **Paint**: Paint an ideally sized Croft area for your animals.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FIRSTCROFT_TEXT_10: Once set up, your **animals** will **feed** to **satiety**, **reproduce**, and **generate** valuable **resources** for your village!
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_1: **Animals** at your Crofts **require** a constant supply of **Fodder resources** to stay **satiated** and **reproduce**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_3: **Assign Fodder**: In the Croft Building Window, assign Fodder resources to your Fodder Depot.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_4: **Ensure Space**: Make sure your Croft Area is large enough and includes the Animal Pen.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_5: **Automatic Feeding**: Farmers will automatically fetch Fodder and feed the animals.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_7: **Satiated Animals**: Well-fed animals reproduce over time, gradually raising their Productivity up to 100%.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_FEEDINGANIMALS_TEXT_8: **Hungry Animals**: If Farmers fail to feed the animals, they will go hungry, which eventually reduces their Productivity.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_1: A **Croft** can include multiple **Animal Pens** and **Fodder Depots**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_2: **Animal Pens**: Each added Animal Pen produces resources individually.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_3: **Fodder Depots**: Each added Fodder Depot can be assigned different Fodder resources.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_4: You can unlock the **Pigsty** and **Goosery** for **Common Crofts** from the **Progression Screen**. **Monastic Crofts** can be expanded with the **Goosery**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_5: Some things to consider when adding **new Animal Pens**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_6: **Land Usage**: Each new Animal Pen increases the required ideal Croft Area.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_7: **Resource Consumption**: Each Animal Pen consumes Fodder resources to keep its animals satiated, with consumption varying depending on the animals housed inside.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_EXPANDINGCROFT_TEXT_8: **Output Multipliers**: Each Animal Pen tracks its own specific Animal Productivity.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_BABYANIMALS_TEXT_1: **Croft productivity** can be further **increased** with the presence of **animal offspring**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_BABYANIMALS_TEXT_2: To get animal offspring, you must:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_BABYANIMALS_TEXT_3: **Maximise Productivity**: Allow an Animal Pen to reach maximum Animal Productivity.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_BABYANIMALS_TEXT_4: **Build Comfort Props**: Construct the appropriate Comfort Prop at the Croft (unlocked by progressing through Harvest Festivals).
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_AGRI_BABYANIMALS_TEXT_5: Once these requirements are fulfilled, **animals** will bring their **offspring** out into the **open**, granting an **Animal Productivity** bonus to that specific **Animal Pen**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_RESOURCES_DYNAMICRECIPES_TEXT_1: Some **workplaces** can produce different **resources** using alternative **Workplace Recipes**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_RESOURCES_DYNAMICRECIPES_TEXT_2: **Unlocking Workplace Recipes**: New productions are granted as you fulfil specific unlock conditions.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_RESOURCES_DYNAMICRECIPES_TEXT_3: **Switching Workplace Recipes**: Once unlocked, you can switch the active production at a Workplace at any time.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_RESOURCES_DYNAMICRECIPES_TEXT_4: **Resource Handling**: When you change a production, any leftover resources will eventually be collected by Villagers.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_RESOURCES_DYNAMICRECIPES_TEXT_5: All **Workplace Recipes** can be **reviewed** in the **Compendium**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_STRATEGY_IMPROVINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: There are **several ways** to **boost** your **score** in future **Harvest Festivals**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_STRATEGY_IMPROVINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_2: **Review the Summary**: Check the end-of-festival Summary Screen to identify areas for improvement.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_STRATEGY_IMPROVINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_3: **Prepare Resources**: Ensure you have enough required resources on hand before starting a Harvest Festival.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_STRATEGY_IMPROVINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_4: **Attract More Villagers**: Increase housing density within your Attractiveness area, or extend its reach to cover distant homes.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_STRATEGY_IMPROVINGFESTIVAL_TEXT_5: **Promote Villagers**: Villagers of higher Status have more Festive Needs, creating greater scoring opportunities.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_BUILDMENUSEARCH_TEXT_1: You can **browse** through the **Build Menu** using the **search bar** located in the **top-right** corner of the menu.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_BUILDMENUSEARCH_TEXT_2: This lets you **search** for **Buildings** using various **keywords**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_MONUMENTSEARCH_TEXT_1: You can **browse** through **Building Parts** using the **search bar** in the **top-right** corner of the **Edit Building Mode** of **Multi-Part Buildings** and **Monuments**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_MONUMENTSEARCH_TEXT_2: This lets you **search** for **Parts** using various **keywords**:
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_MONUMENTSEARCH_TEXT_5: "Splendour": Find all Parts that yield Splendour
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_COMPENDIUM_TEXT_1: Access the **Compendium** from the **top-left** corner of the screen.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_COMPENDIUM_TEXT_2: The **Compendium** is your primary reference for **browsing** in-game content, such as **Workplace Recipes** and **Village Titles**, and checking their unlock **requirements**.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_COMPENDIUM_TEXT_3: **Navigation**: Switch between content types using the bookmarks in the top-right corner.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_COMPENDIUM_TEXT_4: **Filtering**: Refine your view using the filter options on the left.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_USERCOMFORT_COMPENDIUM_TEXT_5: **Unlocking**: Locked and undiscovered entries are revealed as you fulfil their unlock conditions.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_GETTINGSTARTED_FESTIVALGROUNDSINTER: The Festival Grounds interface is divided into two main sections. The **bottom panel** contains the parts available to design your Harvest Festival. Together, these parts establish its Base Attractiveness, which must reach nearby **Residential Areas** for villagers to attend.
The **right panel** presents the Festival setup, including its name and available features, such as Festive Meals, Festive Drinks, and Festive Entertainers.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_GETTINGSTARTED_DESIGNYOURFESTIVAL_T: First, place **Festive Meal Tables** to serve Festive Meals and **Entertainment Sites** to host Festive Entertainers. These interactive parts provide activities for villagers during the Festival.
As your Festival progresses, you will unlock **Festive Drink Tables**, allowing you to serve Festive Drinks during future celebrations.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_GETTINGSTARTED_BOOSTATTRACTIVENESS_: Decorations increase the Attractiveness of nearby interactive parts. Place them close to **Festive Meal Tables**, **Entertainment Sites**, and **Festive Drink Tables** to maximise their Attractiveness.
Thoughtfully decorating your Festival Grounds will help you attract more villagers and achieve a higher Festival Tier.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_GETTINGSTARTED_STARTFESTIVAL_TEXT_1: Once your Festival Grounds are ready, use the **Festival setup panel** and choose the **Festive Meals**, **Festive Drinks**, and **Festive Entertainers** you want to offer.
HELP_TOPICS_CONTENT.HELP_GETTINGSTARTED_STARTFESTIVAL_TEXT_2: Review your preparations, then start the Festival and watch your villagers gather for the celebration!
